description: This file defines the Order model class for the Opencart system, providing methods to retrieve order-related data such as order details, products, totals, histories, and related entities from the database within the 'account' context.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Model class for handling CRUD operations and data retrieval related to customer orders within the Opencart e-commerce system.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order by order ID, including payment and shipping details with associated country and zone codes.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific product within an order by order ID and order product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options for a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for an order product, if any.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total amounts associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history records for an order, including status changes and comments.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders containing a specific product.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total number of products in a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders associated with a specific subscription.

search-terms: getOrder with country and zone codes
